newsitem.title: CHINA: China dissatisfied with U.S. over Taiwan visit.
newsitem.headline: China dissatisfied with U.S. over Taiwan visit.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it had expressed serious concern and dissatisfaction over a U.S. visit by the foreign minister of rival Taiwan.
Washington should restrict to an unofficial level its ties with the island that Beijing regards as a rebel province, Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai told a news briefing.

"The Chinese side has made solemn representations with the U.S. side over the U.S. visit of Taiwan's so-called Foreign Minister John Chang to express the Chinese side's serious concern and dissatisfaction," Cui said.
"The Chinese side has asked the U.S. side to... abide by its promise to restrict U.S.-Taiwan relations to an unofficial arena," Cui said.
"We have always been opposed to the United States and Taiwan engaging in any form of official contact," Cui said.
Chang is currently visiting the United States.
